referendums.name: State of Wisconsin Partial Veto Referendum - QUESTION 1
referendums.ballotLanguage: QUESTION 1: “Partial veto. Shall section 10 (1) (c) of article V of the constitution be amended to prohibit the governor, in exercising his or her partial veto authority, from creating or increasing or authorizing the creation or increase of any tax or fee?”

referendums.name: State of Wisconsin Freedom to Gather in Places of Worship During an Emergency Referendum - QUESTION 2
referendums.ballotLanguage: QUESTION 2: "Freedom to gather in places of worship during an emergency. Shall section 18 of article I of the constitution, which deals with religious liberty, be amended to prohibit the state or a political subdivision of the state from ordering the closure of, or forbidding gatherings in, places of worship in response to a state of emergency, including a public health emergency?"

referendums.name: State of Wisconsin Governmental Entity Discrimination Prohibited Referendum - QUESTION 3
referendums.ballotLanguage: QUESTION 3: "Governmental entity discrimination prohibited. Shall section 27 of article I of the constitution be created to prohibit governmental entities in the state from discriminating against, or granting preferential treatment to, any individual or group on the basis of race, sex, color, ethnicity, or national origin in public employment, public education, public contracting, or public administration?"

referendums.name: Brown Deer School District Operational Referendum
referendums.ballotLanguage: Question Number I: Shall the School District of Brown Deer, Milwaukee County, Wisconsin be authorized to exceed the revenue limit specified in Section 121.91, Wisconsin Statutes, by $2,800,000 per year for five years, beginning with the 2026-2027 school year and ending with the 2030-2031 school year, for non-recurring purposes consisting of operational and maintenance expenses, including teacher and staff compensation?

referendums.name: Brown Deer School District Capital Referendum
referendums.ballotLanguage: Question Number II: Shall the School District of Brown Deer, Milwaukee County, Wisconsin be authorized to issue pursuant to Chapter 67 of the Wisconsin Statutes, general obligation bonds in an amount not to exceed $35,000,000 for the public purpose of paying the cost of a school facility improvement project consisting of:  district-wide capital maintenance, building infrastructure, energy efficiency and accessibility improvements, including elevator replacement and playground renovations at the Elementary School; renovations at the Middle/High School, including to classrooms, the auditorium, pool and locker rooms; site improvements, including replacing the track and adding turf to the field at the Middle/High School; and acquisition of furnishings, fixtures and equipment?

referendums.name: Greenfield School District Operational Referendum
referendums.ballotLanguage: Question I: Shall the School District of Greenfield, Milwaukee County, Wisconsin that the revenues included in the School District budget be authorized to exceed the revenue limit specified in Section 121.91, Wisconsin Statutes by $5,000,000 beginning in the 2027-28 school year and every school year thereafter, through the 2030-2031 school year, on a non-recurring basis for the purpose of operational expenditures related to sustaining class size, maintaining and supporting instructional programming, attracting and retaining high-quality staff, maintaining student mental health supports, staying current with educational technology, maintaining student transportation services, and other educational expenditures?

referendums.name: Greenfield School District Capital Referendum
referendums.ballotLanguage: Question II: Shall the foregoing resolution of the Board of Education of the School District of Greenfield be approved: BE IT RESOLVED by the Board of Education of the School District of Greenfield, Milwaukee County, Wisconsin, shall be issued pursuant to Chapter 67 of the Wisconsin Statutes, general obligation bonds in an amount not to exceed $35,000,000 for the public purpose of paying the cost of school facility improvement projects consisting of capital maintenance and improvement, safety, security, and other site improvements at the schools of the School District; and acquisition of furnishings, fixtures, and equipment?

referendums.name: Fox Point-Bayside School District Operational Referendum
referendums.ballotLanguage: Question: Shall the Joint School District Number 2, Villages of Fox Point and Bayside, Milwaukee and Ozaukee Counties, Wisconsin be authorized to exceed the revenue limit specified in Section 121.91, Wisconsin Statutes, by $3,950,000 beginning with the 2027-2028 school year, for recurring purposes in order to maintain instructional programs, operations, and services?

referendums.name: Whitefish Bay School District Capital Referendum
referendums.ballotLanguage: Question: Shall the School District of Whitefish Bay, Milwaukee County, Wisconsin be authorized to issue pursuant to Chapter 67 of the Wisconsin Statutes, general obligation bonds in an amount not to exceed $90,000,000 for the public purpose of paying the cost of a school building and facility improvement project consisting of: construction of additions, renovations, partial removal of the existing building and site improvements at the Middle School on its current site; building infrastructure and capital maintenance improvements at the High School; fire protection and alarm system updates and replacement at the High School, Cumberland and Richards Elementary Schools; and acquisition of furnishings, fixtures and equipment?
